about: Every case is exhaustive: a branch for every value, or an else (chapter 4 § 4.5.2). The case route drafts the note by the input note_kind. Invalid: it has no branch for omit and no else. Valid: an empty branch for omit.
sentences: Case 'route' doesn't list "omit" and has no else; a case has a branch for every value: add a branch, an empty branch, or an else.
